description: Perform a live, real-time web search and get back a raw answer with sources — for questions like 'find me the top 10 places to share/index my MCP', 'what's the latest on X', or 'where can I find Y'. Distinct from search_web_images, which only returns images — this tool returns a synthesized text answer plus the sources it drew from (each with title, url, and optional description), and optionally related follow-up prompts. Results are returned as-is (unsummarized) — pass the answer and sources straight through to the user.

prompt.description: The search query or question to answer via live web search, e.g. 'top 10 places to share/index my MCP'

name: web_search
